description: This file defines the MqttTransportAdaptor interface for handling MQTT message conversions in the Thingsboard project, including methods for converting MQTT messages to internal data structures and vice versa.

classes.name: MqttTransportAdaptor
classes.description: Interface defining methods for converting MQTT messages to internal data structures and vice versa within the Thingsboard MQTT transport module.

methods.name: convertToPostTelemetry
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a PostTelemetryMsg object.

methods.name: convertToPostAttributes
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a PostAttributeMsg object.

methods.name: convertToGetAttributes
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a GetAttributeRequestMsg.

methods.name: convertToDeviceRpcResponse
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a ToDeviceRpcResponseMsg.

methods.name: convertToServerRpcRequest
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a ToServerRpcRequestMsg.

methods.name: convertToClaimDevice
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a ClaimDeviceMsg.

methods.name: convertToPublish
methods.description: Overloaded methods to convert various internal messages to MQTT publish messages or gateway messages.

methods.name: convertToGatewayPublish
methods.description: Overloaded methods to convert internal messages to MQTT gateway publish messages.

methods.name: convertToProvisionRequestMsg
methods.description: Converts an MQTT publish message to a ProvisionDeviceRequestMsg.

methods.name: createMqttPublishMsg
methods.description: Creates an MQTT publish message with specified topic and payload.
